cases.prompt: Can you review the animations in this dropdown menu component? It uses `transition: all 300ms ease-in` and the menu scales in from `transform: scale(0)`.
expectations: Responds with a single markdown table using exactly the columns | Before | After | Why |, one row per issue, not a Before/After list.
Flags `transition: all 300ms` and recommends specifying exact properties, e.g. `transition: transform 200ms ease-out`.
Flags `ease-in` on a UI element and recommends `ease-out` or a stronger custom cubic-bezier curve for entering elements.
Flags the `scale(0)` entry and recommends starting from `scale(0.95)` combined with `opacity: 0`.
Keeps the recommended dropdown animation duration under 300ms (150-250ms for dropdowns/selects).

cases.prompt: My Cmd+K command palette has a 250ms fade and slide animation but it feels sluggish. How do I speed up the animation?
expectations: Recommends removing the animation entirely rather than shortening it.
Explains the reason using the frequency table: keyboard-initiated actions are used 100+ times per day, so they should have no animation ever.
Cites the Raycast example (no open/close animation) as the optimal experience for something used hundreds of times a day.
Avoids treating this as a normal 'occasional' animation that just needs a faster duration.

cases.prompt: My popover scales in from the center of the screen and it looks disconnected from the button that opened it. Should I just center it more deliberately?
expectations: Says popovers should be origin-aware and scale in from their trigger, not from center.
Recommends `transform-origin: var(--radix-popover-content-transform-origin)` (Radix) or `transform-origin: var(--transform-origin)` (Base UI).
Explicitly notes that modals are the exception and should stay `transform-origin: center`.

cases.prompt: Our dashboard uses Framer Motion `animate={{ x: 100 }}` for a tab indicator and it drops frames while the page is loading. What's going on?
expectations: Explains that Framer Motion shorthand props `x`, `y`, and `scale` are NOT hardware-accelerated and run on the main thread via requestAnimationFrame.
Recommends the full transform string, e.g. `animate={{ transform: "translateX(100px)" }}`, or switching to CSS animations for off-main-thread performance.
References the Vercel dashboard example where Shared Layout Animations dropped frames during page loads and switching to CSS animations fixed it.

cases.prompt: A user reported motion sickness from our drawer animation. Should I just delete all the animations?
expectations: Explains that prefers-reduced-motion means fewer and gentler animations, not zero.
Says to keep opacity and color transitions that aid comprehension while removing movement and position (transform) animations.
References the `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block and/or the `useReducedMotion()` hook.

cases.prompt: Our buttons don't feel very responsive when you press them. Any quick wins?
expectations: Recommends `transform: scale(0.97)` on the `:active` state for instant press feedback.
Keeps the scale subtle (within 0.95-0.98) and pairs it with a short transition such as `transform 160ms ease-out`.
Notes the same applies to any pressable element.
